## Decision from the brief

**go with changes**: Frost Date Planting (niche garden-planner) as the candidate fourth business (blueprint only, no launch). Highest adjusted score in Scout run 2026-11-scout-01 and the only candidate with VERIFIED demand and price evidence that passes every gate. The changes: the free calculator must be the traffic engine, and the paid kit must do what free tools do not (a personal, printable season plan from one frost date).

Falsifying test: If the free planting-calendar pages get 500+ organic or Pinterest sessions between 2027-01-01 and 2027-03-15 and the kit sells nothing, hold the niche. Owner-adjustable rule, not a forecast.

## Positioning

Home vegetable gardeners pay small amounts for printable planners and larger amounts for planning software; free date calculators are everywhere, so the opening is a personal frost-date planting calendar joined to a printable season planner, sold at about $15 before the January to March planning window.

| Segment | Priority |
|---|---|
| Home vegetable gardener (target) | primary |
| Homestead and preserving gardener | secondary |
| Gift buyer | exploratory |

## Products

### Garden Season Kit (working name) (`prd_garden-planner_garden-season-kit`)

core tier · $15 (INFERRED) · playbook `printable-pdf` · PROPOSED

Format: Printable PDF kit + a personal planting calendar sheet generated from one frost date

Must include:
- Personal sowing and transplant calendar for 30 common vegetables and herbs from the buyer's last-frost date
- Bed grid and square-foot spacing pages
- Seed inventory and sowing log
- Harvest log with a 'next year' notes page
- Succession-sowing planner
- US Letter and A4
- Frost dates from NOAA NCEI 1991-2020 normals (50% last-spring 32F date by default), with the station name and distance shown

Must not:
- Give pesticide or legal advice
- Claim exact frost dates; show them as estimates with the source
- Use unlicensed photos

Deliverables:
- **printable** (pdf): Print-tested at Letter and A4; page count and contents match the sales page; accessible type size for the audience.
- **preview-images** (png): Real page renders for the sales page (no mock-ups of pages that do not exist).

Gates: G4, G5, G6, G7, G8, G13

Falsifying test: Fewer than 1 sale per 200 kit-page sessions over the first 1,000 sessions: lower the price to $9 or sell the calendar alone.

### Kit + succession and preserving add-on (`prd_garden-planner_kit-succession-and-preserving-add-on`)

premium tier · $24 (INFERRED) · playbook `bundle` · PROPOSED

Format: Bundle of products (reused or built in this build)

Deliverables:
- **bundle-manifest** (json): Lists every component (existing products and any new item built for the bundle) with file hashes; every component passes G4 on its own.
- **bundle-archive** (zip): Delivered archive equals the reviewed archive (hash match).

Gates: G4, G5, G6, G7, G8, G13

## Sales framework (Promise, Pain, Proof, Plan, Picture)

**Promise (draft):** A season plan printed and on the fridge before seed-starting time, with nothing sown too early or too late.
  - basis: A season plan printed and on the fridge before seed-starting time, with nothing sown too early or too late. _[INFERRED, c_g_out]_

**Pain:**
- Too little time to plan. _[VERIFIED, c_g_pain_time]_
- Forgetting to record results. _[VERIFIED, c_g_pain_tracking]_
- Zone shifts in the 2023 USDA map may leave old planting dates wrong. _[INFERRED, c_g_pain_zone]_

**Proof:** has candidates. No testimonials, ratings, sales counts, user numbers or results until they exist and are verified.
Allowed kinds:
- Previews rendered from the real product files
- Worked example with clearly labelled sample data
- Verified facts from the brief, cited
- Customer feedback only once it exists, with permission

Verified facts the page may cite (these are not testimonials):
- Printables at $3.99-$18 and software at $35-$50/yr are verified price points. _[VERIFIED, c_g_pp_e1]_

**Plan:**
1. Get the Garden Season Kit (working name) for $15
2. Download it straight from the confirmation email
3. Start with: Personal sowing and transplant calendar for 30 common vegetables and herbs from the buyer's last-frost date

**Picture (draft):** _needs a basis in the brief_

**Call to action:** Get the Garden Season Kit (working name)

**Objections to answer on the page:**
- Free date calculators and spreadsheets exist. _[VERIFIED, c_g_obj_free]_
- Printable planners sell from $1.99 off Etsy (Payhip) and from $3.99 on Etsy, and one 41-page planner is free. _[VERIFIED, c_g_obj_cheap]_

**Customer language:**
- “how are you planning out your garden?”
- “can't always remember to enter the results”
- “less than wonderful, but it works (on a garden planner app)”

## Brand

Direction from the brief:
- Planner listings lead with photographed, printed pages in binders; buyers want to see the pages. _[INFERRED, c_g_vis]_

Requirements:
- Designed for this audience, distinct from the other FORGE niches; no generic AI layout
- Licensed or original imagery only, each asset recorded in SOURCES_AND_LICENSES.md
- Accessible type and contrast (WCAG 2.2 AA); readable at 320 px
- Real product previews rendered from the actual files
- Products styled to the same standard as the site that sells them

Unknown provenance is a G8 FAIL. No asset ships without source URL, author, licence, commercial-use terms and attribution recorded.

## Budget and permissions

Budget ceiling: not set (owner to set). Spend authorized: no. A ceiling is a limit, not permission to buy.

Allowed without asking:
- Local development and tests
- Generating product files and previews
- Staging preview deploys
- Draft content and copy
- Test-mode checkout once the owner has connected the account
- Writing FORGE database records for this build

Needs the owner's approval:
- Production deploy or launch
- New accounts or credential connections
- Any purchase or subscription
- Turning on live checkout
- Price changes
- Publishing outside approved campaigns
- Changes to customer data or permissions

Never:
- Fabricated testimonials, reviews, sales counts or results
- Unlicensed images, fonts or text
- Copying another designer's or competitor's work
- Spam, purchased lists or prohibited scraping
- Storing secrets in the repo or dashboard
- Writing sales rows to the ledger
- Touching businesses outside FORGE
